title: Chief Executive Order 23 Conduct of General Elections Fifth Amendment Order 2002

sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 23 Conduct of General Elections Fifth Amendment Order 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 23 OF 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 23 OF 2002
CONDUCT OF GENERAL ELECTIONS (FIIETH
AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
An Order further
to amend the Conduct of General Elections Order, 2002
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part‑I, 21st August, 2002]
F.No.2(4)/2002‑Pub. dated
21‑8‑2002.‑‑‑The following Order promulgated
by the Chief Executive is hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Order may be called the Conduct
of General Elections (Fifth Amendment) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of Article 5, Chief Executive's Order No.7 of 2002

CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 23 OF 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 23 OF 2002
CONDUCT OF GENERAL ELECTIONS (FIIETH
AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
An Order further
to amend the Conduct of General Elections Order, 2002
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part‑I, 21st August, 2002]
F.No.2(4)/2002‑Pub. dated
21‑8‑2002.‑‑‑The following Order promulgated
by the Chief Executive is hereby published for general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of Article 5,
Chief Executive's Order No.7 of 2002.‑‑‑In the Conduct of
General Elections Order, 2002 (Chief Executive's Order No.7 of 2002), in
Article 5, in clause (4), in paragraph (e), after the words "each
political party", the words "from the Province concerned" shall
be inserted.
